## Result

**Counterexample tuple:** `v = (1, 4, 5, 6, 7, 11, 13, 16)`

### Verification summary

| Check | Value | Pass? |
|---|---|---|
| n = 8, 3 ≤ n ≤ 8 | ✓ | yes |
| max element = 16 ≤ 20 | ✓ | yes |
| strictly increasing, all positive | ✓ | yes |
| gcd(1,4,5,6,7,11,13,16) = 1 | ✓ | yes |
| ML(v) ≤ 2/(2·8+1) = 2/17 | merged coverage = [(0, 1)] — full coverage | yes (band tuple) |
| has seed certificate | [] — empty | **no** |

### Replayable evidence

Run from this directory with `python3`:

```python
from search_prep import is_band_tuple, seed_certificates
v = (1, 4, 5, 6, 7, 11, 13, 16)
assert is_band_tuple(v)           # True — it is a band tuple
assert seed_certificates(v) == [] # True — no seed certificate exists
```

**Why no seed certificate:** All 36 candidate sets S with |S| ∈ {1, 2} either (a) have an internal coefficient-two relation (disqualifying them under condition 1), or (b) fail to produce a coefficient-two relation involving every outsider j (disqualifying them under condition 2). The exhaustive per-S trace above documents every case.
